Kerala church grave mystery resolved; object not a third body

A mystery surrounding a church grave in Vaniyappara, Kerala, has been resolved. Initial reports suggested a suspected third body might have been found, prompting plans for a DNA test. However, further investigation clarified that the object discovered was not a human body.
